scope: developer-visible historical replay, no independent benefit claim

cases.goal: Fix the JSON Schema subset validator: required and properties must inspect own fields, never inherited prototype fields. Preserve supported keywords and error paths.
Make snapshotDigest depend on the slot and content digest, independent of instance-specific version IDs. Keep binding order irrelevant and preserve sensitivity to changed slot or content.

Validate capability names at both parseCapabilityModule and capabilityModuleDir. Accept only portable single-segment slugs matching ^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9._-]*[a-z0-9])?$. Invalid parse input must be rejected; invalid direct directory names must throw. Preserve valid modules and existing file traversal validation.
